svg.text: Mimic X Adapter — ATARI / X68000 Joystick
USB-MIDI in from a phone, 9-pin ATARI-standard joystick out. Also emulates a Mega Drive 6-button pad.
• The X68000 port runs at 5 V.
• 3.3 V and the host pull-up puts
• the line back to 5 V — the host
• when the phone and the retro
• BOOT pulls PC17 (USB D+) high via
• 4.7 kΩ for the WCH USB-DFU ROM.
Pin map — CH32X035 ↔ bus switch ↔ D-SUB 9P
PA0 COMMON / TH ← pin 8 MD 6-button select, TIM2_CH1
Every net shown here is declared in the .ato source; this drawing is generated from it by hand, not extracted.
